title: Local Urban Plan Study for the Municipality of Agios Nikolaos
publisher: Ministry of Environment and Energy / Municipality of Agios Nikolaos
role: Lists Schisma, Epano Elounda and Mavrikiano under the Municipal Community of Elounda, and Plaka under the Local Community of Vrouchas.

title: Sustainable Urban Mobility Plan, Municipality of Agios Nikolaos
publisher: Municipality of Agios Nikolaos
role: Identifies the community seat at the coastal settlement of Schisma and gives the local settlement context.

title: Government Gazette B 4821/01.08.2023: 2021 permanent-population results
publisher: Hellenic Ministry of Interior
role: Separately lists the Municipal Communities of Elounda and Vrouchas in the Municipal Unit of Agios Nikolaos.

title: Macrobenthic assemblage structure associated with a Caulerpa prolifera meadow in the eastern Mediterranean Sea (Elounda Bay, Crete Island)
publisher: Regional Studies in Marine Science / Elsevier
role: Defines Elounda Bay as shallow and semi-enclosed, relatively isolated from the outer coastal area of Mirabello Bay.

title: Underwater research in ancient Olous and at the port of Ierapetra
publisher: Hellenic Ministry of Culture and Sports
role: Places ancient Olous at present-day Elounda and records research along Elounda Bay, the Kolokytha peninsula and both sides of Poros.

title: Olous: a submerged city-state
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Supports a concise Olous/Poros orientation without relying on a single-event submergence story.

title: Salt Pans
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Locates the salt-pan landscape on the route from Schisma toward the peninsula.

title: Windmills in Poros
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Places three windmills in Poros near the canal.

title: Fortress of Spinalonga
publisher: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
role: Supports a minimal geographic reference to Spinalonga at the mouth of Elounda's natural harbour; it does not establish World Heritage inscription.

title: Mirabello (Spina Longa etc.)
publisher: R. M. Dawkins' Crete archive, University of Oxford
sourceType: edited primary field notes / archival publication
role: Records the historic spatial sequence around Schisma, Kato and Epano Elounda, Mavrikiano and Plaka, and the cut-and-bridged isthmus; it is not present administrative evidence.

title: Landscape Character Assessment for Sustainable Rural Development in Border Insular Areas: A Case Study of Ano Mirabello, Crete
publisher: Agriculture (MDPI)
role: Provides hilly, terraced and coastal regional context while not defining a single official edge for Mirabello Bay.

title: De l’occupation postpalatiale à la cité-état grecque : le cas du Mirambello (Crète)
publisher: Aegeus Society / Peeters, Aegaeum 40
role: Shows that Mirabello is also a regional archaeological frame around the bay, not a single fixed administrative unit.

title: Shallow Off-Shore Archaeological Prospection with 3-D Electrical Resistivity Tomography: The Case of Olous (Modern Elounda), Greece
publisher: Remote Sensing (MDPI)
authors: Simyrdanis, K.; Papadopoulos, N.; Cantoro, G.
role: Directly documents three-dimensional electrical resistivity tomography of part of submerged Olous, including buried and submerged structural features in the Poros-area archaeological landscape.

title: Surveys in the Mirabello region
publisher: INSTAP Study Center for East Crete
role: Supports the regional survey frame only; it is not used for precise claims about a single site.

title: Portrait of a Polis: Lato Pros Kamara (Crete) in the Late Second Century B.C.
publisher: Hesperia / American School of Classical Studies at Athens
role: Supports the relationship between Lato and its coastal outlet at Kamara and the wider political geography of the area.

title: Salt Pans
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Documents the Mesa and Oxo Elounda complexes, the basin sequence, Fourni labour, Venetian and Ottoman phases, and later monopoly operation.

title: The construction phases of Spinalonga
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Supports the fortification construction beginning in 1579 and its terrain-specific defensive form.

title: Coastal geomorphological changes in a semi-enclosed bay, induced by recreational interventions
publisher: 1st International Conference on the Design and Management of Port, Coastal and Offshore Works
authors: Petrakis, S.; Alexandrakis, G.; Rempis, N.; Kampanis, N.
role: Directly supports the attributed harbour, groyne and seawall chronology. It is retained as a single-source technical record, not treated as equivalent to a peer-reviewed journal article.

title: Places of the Greek-Venetian World: Mirabello
publisher: National Hellenic Research Foundation
role: Indexes Mirabello as a castellum in 1212 and as a turma in 1234; establishes the earliest occurrence currently identified in this research, not the name's absolute first use.

title: The large earthquake of 8 August 1303 in Crete
publisher: Journal of Seismology / CFTI
role: Supports the 1303 Castrum Mirabelli earthquake occurrence.

title: Stadiasmus Maris Magni
publisher: Perseus Digital Library
role: Supports the Cretan sequence in §§351–352: Olous to Kamara, 15 stades; Kamara to Istros, 25 stades.

title: Ancient Olous, Elounda — 2021
publisher: Ephorate of Underwater Antiquities and FORTH / Archaeology in Greece Online
role: Documents 2021 photogrammetry and geophysical investigation around Poros, including features identified up to 1.5 m below the seabed.

title: Geophysical Survey of Underwater Archaeological Sites in Greece
publisher: Remote Sensing (MDPI)
role: Corroborates the role of eustatic sea-level change and tectonic depression in the submerged archaeological setting of Olous.

title: Millennial to million year normal-fault interactions in the forearc of a subduction margin, Crete, Greece
publisher: Journal of Structural Geology
role: Provides the regional Eastern Mirabello Fault System context; it is not used to claim that one fault created the bay.

title: Sedimentological response to Holocene climate events in the Istron area, Gulf of Mirabello, NE Crete
publisher: Quaternary International
role: Supports the compact Istron alluvial-fan, erosion, deposition and shoreline-change context.

title: Ottoman times
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Supports the Ottoman settlement after the 1715 surrender and its historical context.

title: Modern times: The period of the Leper Colony (1903–1957)
publisher: Ephorate of Antiquities of Lasithi, Hellenic Ministry of Culture
role: Supports the 1903 decision, 1904 first transfers, compulsory isolation and 1957 closure of the Leper Colony.
